about.title: Hesperia Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Eleven people died on Hesperia's roads in 2025, according to the city's final collision records. Behind each of those numbers is a High Desert household learning to live with an empty chair. If one of them is yours, you may have questions that no one has answered clearly yet. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil action. It runs on its own track, apart from any criminal charges the San Bernardino County District Attorney may pursue, and it exists to address what the death has cost the people left behind: funeral and burial expenses, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the love, companionship and guidance that cannot be replaced. Fatal collisions here happen on roads residents drive daily, from Main Street and Mariposa Road to the I-15. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Hesperia families with an independent attorney who takes wrongful death cases on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Hesperia Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases, giving priority to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children before certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where you fit before any filing decision is made.

items.title: The two-year clock is real
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity may be responsible. Getting connected early protects that deadline.

items.title: Every loss counted
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The attorney you are matched with works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash that killed my husband happened on the I-15 through Hesperia. Does that change anything?
items.answer: It can. If a road design, signal, or maintenance issue on a state highway or city street contributed to the death, part of the claim may involve a government entity, and California gives you far less than two years to act against a public agency. That is one reason we encourage Hesperia families to get connected with an attorney quickly rather than waiting for the crash report to be finalized.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges in San Bernardino County. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves independently of any criminal prosecution. The outcome of the criminal case can matter as evidence, but your two-year deadline does not pause while it plays out, so it is wise to have an attorney reviewing your options now.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing at all. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and we do not take a portion of any recovery. The independent attorney you are matched with handles wrongful death cases on a contingency basis, which means you pay no attorney fee unless there is a recovery.
